annotations.title: Add/remove/toggle a Bing ignored query parameter

description: AddQueryParameter + RemoveQueryParameter + EnableDisableQueryParameter: add, remove, or toggle one query-string parameter Bing is told to ignore when canonicalizing URLs for a project's matched site. FREE (no credits), but this is a MUTATION. get_bing_site_overview's queryParameters field (GetQueryParameters) is the read half of this family. Bring-your-own-key: requires BING_WEBMASTER_API_KEY. Answers { ok: false, reason: 'not_configured' } when unset, or 'no_matching_site' when the project's domain has no verified match on the account.

action.description: add: start ignoring this parameter. remove: stop ignoring it entirely. enable/disable: toggle an already-added rule without removing it.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: update_bing_query_parameter
